title: SREV-011 named-pipe LPC connect reply shape

internal_api_caveat.description: winternl.h APIs are internal Windows surface that can change between releases; NtConnectPort connection-info semantics are not a documented public contract

reply_wire_layout.description: NAMED_PIPE_LPC_CONNECT_RPL = { MSG_HEADER h; ULONG handle; ULONG max_msg_len; ULONG info_len; UCHAR info_data[1]; }; h.length is the allocated reply byte length

fixed_field_gate.description: Successful replies must prove h.length >= FIELD_OFFSET(NAMED_PIPE_LPC_CONNECT_RPL, info_data) before reading handle, max_msg_len, info_len

payload_fit_gate.description: info_len must satisfy info_len <= h.length - FIELD_OFFSET(NAMED_PIPE_LPC_CONNECT_RPL, info_data); failure returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER

copy_clamp.description: memcpy length is min(reply_info_len, caller_capacity); ConnectionInfoLength reports the reply's declared length

short_reply_invariant.description: Failed replies may legally be SHORT_REPLY(status) carrying only MSG_HEADER; successful replies cannot be short

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate: malformed replies fail closed; normal LPC connect with connection info still works

contracts: The pre-patch no-op clamp `if (rpl->info_len < info_len) info_len = info_len;` must be removed
Successful replies prove h.length covers fixed reply fields before any trusted access
info_len must fit inside h.length - FIELD_OFFSET(NAMED_PIPE_LPC_CONNECT_RPL, info_data)
ConnectionInfoLength receives the reply's declared info_len even when payload is clamped to caller capacity
